'''Ryan James Anderson''' (born [[May 6]] [[1988]], in [[Sacramento, California]]) is a second-year [[college basketball]] player. Anderson plays the [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]] position at the [[University of California, Berkeley]].

On [[April 3]], [[2008]], Anderson declared himself eligible for the [[2008 NBA draft]].<ref>[http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2008/news/story?id=3328301 Cal sophomore Anderson will try NBA draft]</ref> He did not take an agent, leaving himself the option to return to Cal if he withdraws his name from the draft before [[June 16]].

==College==

Anderson is a highly touted [[power forward]] in the competetive Pac-10. He has emerged as California's best player, and he led the [[Pac-10]] in scoring in the 2007-2008 season, averaging 21.6 points per game. Although California failed to reach the [[NCAA men's basketball tournament]], Anderson was an essential part of their [[National Invitational Tournament]] bid.  

==High School==

Anderson graduated from [[Oak Ridge High School (El Dorado Hills, California)|Oak Ridge High School]] in [[El Dorado Hills, California]] in [[2006]].  His team won the state championship during his junior season. Anderson was third-leading high school scorer in the state of California as a senior in 2005-06, averaging 28.9 ppg. He also averaged 10.9 rpg and 3.9 bpg, shooting 55.8 percent from the floor, 33.1 percent from three-point range (41-124) and 83.9 percent from the free throw line.
